units.source_text: 接着，十一日由童男童女参拜祇园社。

en.t: Next, on the eleventh, the young boys and girls paid a visit to Gion Shrine.

units.source_text: 他们是乘坐长刀彩车去的。

en.t: They went there riding on the Naginata float.

units.source_text: 童男童女跨在马上，头戴乌帽，身穿猎服，由侍从陪同去接受五位官衔。

en.t: The young boys and girls sat astride horses, wearing black court caps and hunting robes, and went with attendants to receive the court rank of Fifth Rank.

units.source_text: 五位以上就是“殿上人” [1] 了。

en.t: Those of Fifth Rank or above were known as “tenjobito,” nobles permitted to enter the palace.
